item.title: Daily News Brief — Nov 05, 2026: Morgan Stanley tokenizes stocks and Treasuries through DTCC
item.description:
Thursday edition covering Wednesday, November 4 through Thursday morning, November 5, 2026. Morgan Stanley becomes the first named bank to confirm it has tokenized US equities and Treasuries through the DTCC Tokenization Service, a day after Societe Generale took DTCC-tokenized Treasuries as collateral, while its own tokenized equity ATS slips to Q1 2027. Canton Strategic Holdings completes the first issuer-sponsored tokenized US stock trades under the SEC innovation exemption, with Fairmint as transfer agent and Flowdesk providing liquidity on TSV, the direct alternative to the DTC model. Circle beats Q3 estimates on $182 million of Arc presale revenue as reserve income falls 8%, USDC share slips and staff is cut 5%. Also: Schroders' emerging market bond fund on Solana via Centrifuge, BitGo Global Markets, the post-election outlook for CLARITY and Senate Banking, the OCC GENIUS Act rule details, LSEG's digital depository clearing the UK sandbox, the DeFi vault split at the SEC, and Credit Mutuel Arkea's confirmed $133 million theft.

item.title: Daily News Brief — Nov 04, 2026: Democrats take Congress as SocGen puts DTCC-tokenized Treasuries to work as collateral
item.description:
Wednesday edition covering Tuesday, November 3 through Wednesday morning, November 4, 2026, the morning after the US midterms. Democrats win control of Congress, putting Elizabeth Warren in line to chair Senate Banking and leaving the stalled CLARITY Act with only a lame-duck window. Societe Generale accepts $10 million of DTCC-tokenized US Treasuries as collateral on Canton, with on-chain repo next, while Eurex declares itself the first hybrid CCP as the ESM's digital bond becomes eligible for GC Pooling and margin. The SEC staff treats Canton Coin as a digital commodity in a no-action letter, the CFTC clears single-stock perpetual futures for US exchanges, and OKX ICE objections reach 56 at the first notice deadline. Also: Wachtell's guidance to issuers on tokenized securities, Bullish going multi-chain, the alleged $133 million theft tied to Credit Mutuel Arkea, and what to watch from Circle's earnings.

item.title: Daily News Brief — Nov 03, 2026: Hong Kong takes tokenized deposits to 24/7 central bank money settlement
item.description:
Tuesday edition covering Monday, November 2 through Tuesday morning, November 3, 2026, a lighter day dominated by Hong Kong FinTech Week. The HKMA moves Ensemble TX to 24/7 settlement in tokenized central bank money with twelve banks and twenty participants, completes trial trades in tokenized Exchange Fund Bills aimed at repo with regulated stablecoins to follow, and Standard Chartered launches tokenized deposits for Hong Kong corporates on those rails, alongside a planned interbank gold token. NYSE signs Broadridge, Computershare, Equiniti and Superstate as transfer agents for its tokenized venue, raising the question of where a tokenized share's golden record lives relative to DTC, while StoneX argues DTCC's launch validates Securitize and tZERO agrees a $350 million SPAC merger. In collateral, Advent agrees to buy Vermeg with ADIA, HKEX clearing houses begin accepting Chinese government bonds as margin, and Consensys unveils a cross-ledger collateral allocation stack. Also: HSBC RedCoin at 50,000 users, Binance's phased recovery and November 4 reserve snapshot, Ghana's stablecoin directive, and what to watch on election day.

item.title: Daily News Brief — Oct 30, 2026: Binance loses $6.3 billion in record hack as issuers freeze stablecoins
item.description:
Friday edition covering Thursday, October 29 through Friday morning, October 30, 2026. Binance says about $6.3 billion was taken from its hot wallets in the largest crypto theft on record, apparently through an EIP-7702 delegation signed via a compromised engineer's laptop, and about $3 billion has been frozen, including more than $1.5 billion of USDT by Tether, about $823 million of USDC by Circle and about $200 million of RLUSD by Ripple, which makes it the largest live test yet of stablecoin freeze powers and DeFi circuit breakers. The Bank of England consults on supervisory expectations for CCPs accepting tokenised collateral, saying the current framework is no barrier if the collateral can be valued, transferred and realised under stress. ICE signs a definitive agreement with Trade[XYZ] to bring Hyperliquid-style perpetual futures onshore with a new retail clearing structure, and OKX ICE stock-token objections reach 38 with Walmart and Eli Lilly, while Canton-based TSV says the first trade under the SEC innovation exemption could come Monday. Also: Chainlink 24/7 pricing for tokenized assets with Aave as first adopter, the CPMI's report on the role of central bank money, Galaxy's OCC trust bank application, DTCC's 2027 roadmap to Stellar and Arc, and Coinbase's MiCA stablecoin conversion.
